primary_goal: Guide the visitor to select a size and click 'Jetzt kaufen' to add the sneaker to cart and proceed to purchase.

first_screens.screen_1: Top navigation and search (~10%), large main image gallery with thumbnails (~45%), buy box with product title, price (€107.95), color variants, size selector dropdown, and 'Jetzt kaufen' CTA (~45%).
first_screens.screen_2: Right column shipping details, 30-day return policy, expandable product accordions (Material, Details, Fit) (~45%), massive empty white space on the left (~45%), and top of recommendation carousel (~10%).

friction_points.issue: Massive dead white space on the left side of the screen as the user scrolls past the main product image.
friction_points.evidence: In Screen 2, the left 50% of the viewport is completely blank while product details and shipping information continue on the right column.

friction_points.issue: Product displays a 'Top bewertet' badge, but lacks visible star ratings and customer review counts.
friction_points.evidence: In Screen 1, the red/white 'Top bewertet' badge appears on the image, but there are no star rating icons or review metrics near the product title or price.

friction_points.issue: Size selector is hidden inside a standard dropdown menu instead of displaying visible size tiles with inventory availability.
friction_points.evidence: In Screen 1, the size selection field reads 'Bitte Größe wählen' with a dropdown arrow, requiring an extra click to reveal available sizes.

friction_points.issue: Secondary image thumbnails on the left require vertical scrolling/clicking arrows rather than seamless horizontal or interactive view.
friction_points.evidence: In Screen 1, a small down-arrow icon appears below the 5th vertical thumbnail on the left gallery column.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace the size dropdown menu with visible inline size buttons showing real-time stock indicators, then add-to-cart rate will increase because shoppers can immediately see if their size is available with one less click.
hypotheses.change: Display size grid/pills directly below the color selector instead of inside a dropdown field.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add visible star ratings (e.g. 4.8 ★★★★★ (245)) next to the product price and title, then buy button click-through rate will increase because buyers receive instant social proof validation.
hypotheses.change: Include star rating summary link right below the product title in Screen 1.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we make the product buy box sticky on the right side as users scroll through details, then conversion rate will increase because the 'Jetzt kaufen' button remains constantly accessible.
hypotheses.change: Implement sticky sidebar behavior for the right column containing price, size selector, and CTA button.

quick_wins: Add star rating text alongside the existing 'Top bewertet' badge.
Show explicit stock warnings (e.g. 'Nur noch wenige verfügbar') inside the size selector.
uncertainties: Whether clicking the size dropdown shows immediate out-of-stock indicators.
Exact mobile layout presentation for the buy box and image gallery.
